summary: HeartCore Enterprises filed an 8-K reporting a definitive Capital Contribution Portion Transfer Agreement dated August 3, 2026, selling its entire 51% stake in Heartcore Luvina Vietnam Company Limited to Luvina Software Joint Stock Company, which held the remaining 49%. Consideration is JPY 29,000,000 (~$184,093) in cash, with closing expected on or before August 14, 2026. The agreement includes customary reps, warranties, and covenants; a press release was issued August 7. Watch for closing confirmation and any post-sale adjustments; the small size suggests a strategic exit from Vietnam operations.
